# The Elevated Cart

> Recreated designer rooms, styling guides and Pottery Barn look-alikes, all shoppable on Amazon. Every guide gives a short answer, a numbered piece list and styling rules.

## Style guides

- [How to Layer a Neutral Bed](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/layered-neutral-bed/): Build five layers in one color family: crisp sheets, a light duvet or coverlet, a folded quilt a shade darker, a textured throw near the foot, and pillows (two sleeping pillows, two euro shams, one lumbar). Varying texture is what makes it look designer.
- [How High to Hang Art Above a Sofa](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/art-above-sofa/): Hang it so the bottom of the frame sits 8 to 10 inches above the top of the sofa back, and choose art or a grouping about two-thirds the width of the sofa.
- [The Rug Size Guide](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/rug-size-guide/): Most living rooms need an 8x10 or larger so at least the front legs of every seat sit on the rug. In a dining room, the rug should extend about 24 inches past the table on every side.
- [The Coffee Table Formula](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/coffee-table-formula/): Use three groupings: something tall like a vase, something low like a stack of books with a small object on top, and something living like branches or a plant. Keep about a third of the surface open.
- [How to Style a Nightstand](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/nightstand-styling/): Start with a lamp tall enough that the shade sits around shoulder height when you sit up in bed, add a small stack of books for lift, and finish with one personal item. Keep chargers in a drawer.
- [The Throw Pillow Formula](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/throw-pillow-formula/): Place two 22-inch squares at each end, two 20-inch squares in a second texture in front of them, and one lumbar in the middle. Stay in one color family and vary the textures.
- [How to Size a Dining Chandelier](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/dining-chandelier-size/): Choose a fixture about half to two-thirds the width of the table, and hang the bottom 30 to 36 inches above the tabletop.
- [How to Style a Sideboard](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/sideboard-styling/): Center a round mirror or large art as the anchor, add height on one side with a tall vase or candleholder, soften it with greenery, and balance the other side with a smaller grouping.
- [The Entryway Drop Zone](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/entryway-drop-zone/): Give it four parts: a bench for shoes, hooks at two heights, one basket per person and a tray for keys. Give every item one home so it stays clear.
- [A Warm, Simple Thanksgiving Table](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/thanksgiving-table/): Start with a linen runner or tablecloth, lay fall branches low down the center, add candles under glass at a few heights, and finish with woven placemats and fringe napkins. Keep the centerpiece below eye level.
- [The Winter Mantel](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/winter-mantel/): Choose one big anchor piece like a painting or mirror, add candlesticks and vases in groups of three or five, and finish with natural texture like branches or greenery.
- [Why Does Your Tree Look Flat?](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/designer-christmas-tree/): Tuck lights deep inside along the branches, add wide ribbon in loose cascades, and hang ornaments in three sizes: large ones deep inside, medium in the middle and small on the tips.
- [Is Your Tree Missing This?](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/tree-base-styling/): Use a woven tree collar or a large basket wide enough to cover the stand with a few inches to spare, then layer a throw or wrapped gifts around the base.
- [Flannel Season: A Cozy Christmas Bedroom](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/cozy-christmas-bedroom/): Swap in plaid or flannel pillow covers, add a chunky knit throw at the foot of the bed, hang a small wreath above the headboard and use warm lamp light.
- [Tree Lights On, Overheads Off](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/christmas-eve-living-room/): Turn on tree and garland lights and table lamps, light candles under glass, turn the overhead lights off, and add throws and holiday pillow covers to every seat.
- [Christmas Morning: Set It the Night Before](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/christmas-morning-table/): Set it the night before with a linen runner, woven placemats, plaid or fringe napkins with simple rings, greenery in a low vase and a hurricane candle in the center.
- [The Cocoa Corner](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/cocoa-corner/): Use one tray to corral everything, keep mugs within reach, put toppings like marshmallows and peppermint in clear jars, and add a little greenery.
- [Christmas Coffee Table Decor Ideas](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/christmas-coffee-table-decor/): Start with one large round tray, add a low cedar garland, three brass taper candles at different heights, a candle ring for a touch of red, a short stack of books and a few bottle brush trees. Keep everything under 12 inches and leave a third of the table clear.
- [Christmas Entryway Table Decor](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/christmas-entryway-table-decor/): Center a mirror over the console and hang a wreath on it with velvet ribbon, flank it with a matching pair of lamps, and add one tall vase of pine branches off center. Keep the middle clear for keys and mail.
- [Kitchen Christmas Decor Ideas](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/kitchen-christmas-decor-ideas/): Hang mini wreaths on the upper cabinet doors, swap in red and white striped towels, set a pedestal bowl of red ornaments on the counter, add a tree-shaped serving board and put pine branches in a crock. Keep most of the counter clear.
- [Christmas Tree Color Ideas: 3 Formulas That Always Work](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/christmas-tree-color-ideas/): Three formulas always work: brown and gold (brown velvet ribbon with champagne mercury glass), blue and ivory (dusty blue velvet bows, blue and ivory floral ribbon and navy, powder blue and gold ornaments), and ribbon as the garland (camel velvet and champagne ribbon swags). Stick to two colors and finish with a woven tree collar.
- [Christmas Table Decor Ideas](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/christmas-table-decor-ideas/): Layer round woven placemats, classic Christmas tree dinner plates and tartan cloth napkins, then run a cedar garland down the center with brass taper holders and white candles. Keep the centerpiece under 14 inches.
- [Gift Wrapping Ideas That Look Expensive (Plus Gifts Under $50)](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/gift-wrapping-ideas-that-look-expensive/): Use one plain paper like brown kraft on every gift, tie it with velvet ribbon in two alternating colors, add a plain kraft tag and tuck a dried orange slice into the bow.
- [Christmas Hostess Gift Ideas for the Hostess Who Has Everything](https://theelevatedcart.com/guides/hostess-gift-ideas-christmas/): Bring something she can use after the party or keep for years: Christmas cloth napkins, linen cocktail napkins, holiday tea towels, a marble wine cooler with a bottle inside, a Spode Christmas Tree serving piece or a Lenox ornament.
